request.note: No payload. The handler does not read `data`. The official client still sends `{success: 1, width, height, scale}` (js/game.js:7452), but the code that read `width`, `height` and `scale` is a comment now (node/server.js:5034).

responses.name: Snapshot
responses.when: The server makes the observer and sends everything in its view. Before it, `disappear` events can come, as for `send_updates` (the new observer saw nothing before, so usually none).

responses.name: Broadcast camera
responses.when: Only for a socket with the query `broadcast=1`, without `no_graphics=1`, and with no `secret` character. The server must not be PvP, and `gameplay` must be `"normal"`. The server sends it at once after `entities`, and again each time that the camera changes.
responses.summary: The state of the broadcast camera: `{group, party, focus, map, x, y, online, remaining_ms, kind, available, town_players}`. See the `observer_broadcast` entry. When the camera must move, a `new_map` follows (`transport_observer_to`, node/server.js:4613-4638).

rows.when: The socket is not connected, it has a character or an observer already, or a login attempt runs (`socket.login_attempt`).

order: only for a broadcast camera: `observer_broadcast`, and `new_map` when the camera moves
